description: This file implements the NetworkInterfaceManager class, which manages network interfaces using netlink sockets. It includes functions to build netlink requests, open network interfaces by name, and apply configuration changes.

classes.name: NetworkInterfaceManager
classes.description: Manages network interfaces via netlink socket communication, allowing to open interfaces and apply configuration changes.

methods.name: BuildLinkRequest
methods.description: Constructs a netlink request to set link (interface) parameters.

methods.name: BuildAddrRequest
methods.description: Constructs a netlink request to add an address to a network interface.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaceManager::New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of NetworkInterfaceManager, optionally using a provided NetlinkClientFactory.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaceManager::Open
methods.description: Opens a network interface by name or alternate name, returning a NetworkInterface object.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaceManager::ApplyChanges
methods.description: Applies configuration changes to a network interface via netlink requests.
